title: Find all charter schools in Los Angeles County that serve grades 9 through
question: Find all charter schools in Los Angeles County that serve grades 9 through 12 and have more than 800 but fewer than 2,000 free meals for students aged 5–17. Return each school’s name, full mailing address (MailStreet, MailCity, MailState, MailZip), the administrator’s first and last name, and the eligible free rate for students aged 5–17.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  s.XCL_047 AS SchoolName,
  s.XCL_053 AS MailStreet,
  s.XCL_055 AS MailCity,
  s.XCL_057 AS MailState,
  s.XCL_056 AS MailZip,
  s.XCL_080 AS AdminFirstName,
  s.XCL_081 AS AdminLastName,
  f.XCL_026 AS EligibleFreeRate
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
WHERE s.XCL_063 = 1
  AND s.XCL_045 = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.XCL_075 = '9-12'
  AND f.XCL_025 > 800
  AND f.XCL_025 < 2000
